card.name: Start of split drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is split across pieces, mostly a drug or nutrient name such as "do" before xorubicin, "prov" before itamin, or "ado" before -trastuzumab. Also fires on "e.g." before a brand name.

card.plain: It marks the first chunk of a long drug name, such as doxorubicin, where the rest of the word is still to come.
